parameters.query: SELECT portal, status, EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (now() - updated_at))::bigint AS age_secs, EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (now() - last_ok))::bigint AS last_ok_secs FROM portal_cookies ORDER BY portal

SELECT id, source, url, title, rent_gross, rent_net, rooms, m2, commune, fit_score, triage->>'price_tier' AS price_tier FROM listings WHERE first_seen > now() - interval '24 hours' AND status NOT IN ('seeded','dup') ORDER BY fit_score DESC NULLS LAST, first_seen DESC
